overview: You stood over a sheet that carried the phrase and no title you took. The quire under your arm was blank. Fivepence left your hand. You did not write a sum on the paper.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Read the phrase, paid, and carried blank paper out of the yard.

assets.name: fivepence
assets.disposition: Took the phrase and the blank paper

summary: Took the phrase and the blank paper
